args.prompt: Three hits on the beat; camera bumps on each hit. Three kids from the crew sit on the hood of a boxy 80s sedan under the overpass, stamping the beat with their fists on the hood, one slapping a skateboard deck; sodium light, graffiti on the pillars. Camera: Medium, three-quarter angle, fisheye edge distortion. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, dusk under a highway overpass, sodium light, film grain, VHS softness. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
